title: Wall 5 Gysin Quarter-Projector Exactness and Invertible Transfer Kernels in Hodge Theory
description: We prove that the Gysin pushforward and pullback maps under geometric blow-ups resolve the identity into four mutually orthogonal quarter-projectors, ensuring that algebraic cycle energy is conserved with zero dissipation across singular transitions. We formalize this exact transfer kernel in Lean 4 with zero sorry. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
